ladder.name: Servant
ladder.duty: Carry, clean and learn to stand straight.
ladder.privilege: A roof, rations and the outer yard.

ladder.name: Outer Disciple
ladder.duty: Drill the forms and run the sect's errands.
ladder.privilege: Outer hall lessons and the training yard.

ladder.name: Inner Disciple
ladder.duty: Cultivate in earnest and answer for the outer yard.
ladder.privilege: The inner library and a cultivation mat.

ladder.name: Core Disciple
ladder.duty: Guard the sect's name abroad and teach what you know.
ladder.privilege: Core hall keys and a seat at the elders' table.

ladder.name: Elder
ladder.duty: Hold a hall, judge disputes and keep the vein accounted.
ladder.privilege: A voice in the hall and the right to open the vaults.

ladder.name: Deputy
ladder.duty: Answer for every gate and every disciple beneath you.
ladder.privilege: Command of the gates in the master's absence.

ladder.name: Sect Master
ladder.duty: Hold the seat and answer for every gate.
ladder.privilege: The seat, the seal and the final word.

offices.name: Instructor
offices.duty: Teach the forms and test who is ready.
offices.privilege: The training yard and the right to judge a student.

offices.name: Guardian
offices.duty: Stand the gate and answer for the sect's walls.
offices.privilege: The gate watch and the wall keys.
